image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a maypole celebration. The image features a tall pole (partially obscured) with numerous colorful ribbons (red, green, yellow, blue) extending from the top downwards. A crowd of people, including children and adults, are gathered at the base, holding the ends of the ribbons. The background shows urban buildings with windows, suggesting a street festival or public square setting rather than a traditional grassy field.
